subject: general
question:
Which of the following pairs is correct in terms of pH values?

(a) Tooth decay in humans: pH of mouth > 5.5

(b) pH range of human body: 7.0 to 7.8

(c) Acid rain: pH of rain water > 8
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Only (b) is correct.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **pH range of the human body** is approximately **7.0 to 7.8**. This range is essential for maintaining proper biological functions, as the body operates optimally within this slightly alkaline range.
 
• The body's **buffer systems**, such as the bicarbonate buffer system, help maintain this pH range to support **enzyme activity, oxygen transport, and metabolic processes**.
 
• A deviation from this pH range can result in conditions like **acidosis (too acidic)** or **alkalosis (too alkaline)**, which can disrupt essential bodily functions.
 
• This pH range is regulated by organs like the **lungs and kidneys**, which play a crucial role in maintaining acid-base balance in the body.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Tooth decay in humans: pH of mouth > 5.5**__

 __
 
• This statement is **incorrect** because **tooth decay occurs when the pH of the mouth falls below 5.5**. At this pH level, the enamel, which is primarily composed of hydroxyapatite, begins to demineralize.
 
• Low pH in the mouth is often caused by the presence of **acidic byproducts from bacterial activity** during the breakdown of sugars.
 
• To prevent tooth decay, it is important to maintain good oral hygiene and limit the consumption of sugary foods and drinks.
 
 
 
• **Acid rain: pH of rainwater > 8**__
 
 
• This statement is **incorrect** because **acid rain has a pH less than 5.6**, not greater than 8.
 
• Acid rain is caused by the presence of **sulfur dioxide (SO₂)** and **nitrogen oxides (NOₓ)** in the atmosphere, which react with water to form sulfuric acid and nitric acid.
 
• The impacts of acid rain include damage to **forests, aquatic ecosystems, and buildings**, as well as harm to soil quality.
